text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove has WON the Shuka Sho!
Incredible!
And with this victory...

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove is the Triple Tiara champion!
We've
just witnessed the birth of an
unbeatable empress!

text_block_list.name: Male Fan
text_block_list.text:
A-amazing! I'm so glad I came today!
You're the
best, Air Groove! Congrats!

text_block_list.name: Female Fan
text_block_list.text: Sniffle... Ohhh, Air Groove! You were so great!

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: Em-press! Em-press! Em-press! Em-press!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Everyone here at Kyoto Racecourse has
erupted
in cheers for the Empress! We
have witnessed
history today, folks! Give
it up for Air Groove!
Congratulations!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
We've achieved something truly great
here today.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Heh. I believe I told you I would do your
hard
work justice.
choice_data_list: トリプルティアラ、おめでとう

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: You've been great too. Thanks again.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With cheers roaring behind us, we begin
to make
our way back to the waiting
room.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Air Groove!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Dober?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations on winning the Shuka
Sho! I, um,
just wanted to say something
to you...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Watching you take on the Triple Tiara...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: It really changed me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Air Groove... You are my ideal.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Thank you... for always being there.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to work tirelessly to catch up
with you.
I'm going to get closer with
each passing day.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Until eventually... I surpass you!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: That's the spirit.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Don't stop chasing after me. I look
forward to the
day we meet on the track.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: R-right!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, Air Groove. And...
thank you!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Heh. She's matured quite a bit.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: That I did. But I'm not satisfied yet.
choice_data_list_en: You kept your promise, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Being someone's ideal is a lifelong task.
For the
sake of all Umamusume who look
up to me...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I need to aim for even greater heights
and grow
even stronger.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Heh.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: That's why you're my trainer.
